entry.title: Adding an AI Slop Linter to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Actions
entry.summary: The cleanest anti-slop setup splits prevention from verification: load the pure-Markdown Skill before drafting so agents avoid stock templates, then run the offline `dislop check` CLI locally or on `--changed` PR lines. For office agents without local shells, connect `https://dislop.com/mcp`.

entry.title: 4 Anti-Slop Agent Skills Tested on 30 Real Drafts (2026 Benchmark)
entry.summary: Upfront disclosure: pass-rate scores use dislop's own deterministic packs. Across 30 drafts on gemini-3.5-flash, all four standalone Markdown skills left dead href=\"#\" links in HTML cards, stop-slop left raw **Summary**: markdown and 62.5% text shrink inside .pptx XML, and 3 of 4 returned a three-semicolon pitch verbatim. Adding one dislop check pass lifted clean passes by +13.3 pp in English and +20.0 pp in Chinese with 0 fact drift.

entry.title: Cleaning Up AI-Generated PowerPoint Decks and Word Docs (PPTX / DOCX / PDF)
entry.summary: AI-generated Office deliverables break in five predictable ways: pasted `**bold**` Markdown asterisks, 120+ word slide walls, >6 bullets per slide, shrunk `normAutofit` fonts below 80%, and vague titles like 'Overview' or 'Analysis of Q3 Retention'. Inspect the OOXML and PDF text layers deterministically before sending.

entry.title: Fixing AI Slop in Web UI: Beyond Purple Gradients, Pill Soup, and Dead Buttons
entry.summary: AI-generated web UIs look interchangeable when they fall back on purple-pink gradients, pill-badge walls, 3-level nested cards, fake macOS window dots, and dead href='#' buttons. Replace template chrome with 1px structural grids, clear type hierarchy, and deterministic HTML/CSS linting.

entry.title: AI Slop Linter vs. AI Detectors vs. Prompt Skills: How to Choose in 2026
entry.summary: Probabilistic AI detectors only output a guess percentage without telling you what to fix; Markdown skills improve first drafts but slip under long contexts; deterministic linters (Vale, dislop) give repeatable, line-level pass/fail gates across CI, web UI, and slides. Use skills upfront and linters at the gate.

entry.title: How to Remove AI Slop From Writing Without Triggering Second-Order Clichés
entry.summary: Banning stock words alone forces LLMs to swap buzzwords for second-order templates like 'Not X, but Y' slogans, three-word staccato chains, and moralizing endings. Replace clichés by running the Deletion Test on flagged spans and re-checking after edits.

entry.title: What Is AI Slop? A 2026 Field Guide Across Prose, Web UI, and Slide Decks
entry.summary: AI slop is unreviewed, low-signal machine output driven by statistical averaging. Beyond banned words like 'delve' and 'tapestry', it shows up as 'Not X, but Y' contrast slogans, purple-pink SaaS web templates, dense PowerPoint word walls, and stray chatbot greetings.
